newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles transit agency sets meeting on CEO.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles transit agency sets meeting on CEO.

text.p: The Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority said its board of directors would meet Thursday to discuss the transition of leadership following the resignation of its chief executive.
The authority said in a statement that the board would meet in closed session to discuss CEO Joseph Drew's resignation. His resignation becomes effective on Friday.

"The board needs to settle several leadership issues including the morale of the agency, transition to new leadership and the response of the public to this turn of events," Board Chairman Larry Zarian said.
